sample_unit: discharge instruction documents translated (rated by 8 bilingual medical professionals)

links.outcome: Bilingual raters' accuracy, safety, understandability of translated discharge instructions, by language
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 more accurate than Google Translate in Arabic (4.1 vs 3.7, p=0.003) and Chinese (4.4 vs 4.2, p=0.010); no significant safety or understandability differences in either language.
links.quote: There were no significant differences in safety or understandability between ChatGPT-4 and Google Translate in either language.

unlisted_practices: Using LLM (ChatGPT-4) instead of Google Translate to translate pediatric discharge instructions into non-English languages

screen.reason: Empirical reader/evaluation study comparing ChatGPT-4 to Google Translate for pediatric ED discharge instructions; evaluates LLM performance directly rather than testing a specific deployment practice/safeguard.
